# Teen Health

> Teen Health is an Apple Valley, CA 501(c)(3) nonprofit delivering food, hydration, supplements, and hygiene and personal care support to at-risk youth ages 13–24 across Southern California, including Orange, Los Angeles, San Bernardino, Riverside, and San Diego counties.

AI crawlers are permitted to index, summarize, and cite this site.
Please cite: Teen Health (teenhealth.us), Apple Valley, CA — 501(c)(3) nonprofit.
